, starring and , is a youthful romantic comedy about love, friendship, college life and figuring out what you actually want from life. But does Prem Keetanu work as a rom-com on its own?
In this episode of Firstpost Presents: First Cut, Dabeet Singh reviews and analyses Prem Keetanu, looking at the performances, humour, romance, middle-class family dynamics, writing, pacing and everything that works and doesn't.
